faqs.question: How much does a small business website cost?
faqs.answer: Our websites are on monthly plans from $199/month, which includes design, hosting, security and updates. There is no upfront fee. A traditional agency build typically costs $5,000–$15,000 upfront, plus hosting and maintenance.

faqs.question: How long does it take to design a website?
faqs.answer: You'll see your homepage preview within 5 business days. Most small business websites launch within 2–3 weeks.

faqs.question: Will my website work on mobile?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every site is designed mobile-first and tested on phones, tablets and desktops before launch.

faqs.question: Can you redesign my existing website?
faqs.answer: Yes. We redesign your current site and keep your important URLs and redirects in place so you keep the Google rankings you already have.

faqs.question: Do I need to write the content myself?
faqs.answer: No. We can write and structure your page copy for you, based on a short conversation about your business.

faqs.question: How long does SEO take to work?
faqs.answer: Most businesses see early movement within 2–3 months and stronger results within 4–6 months. Local SEO for less competitive areas can be faster.

faqs.question: How much do SEO services cost per month?
faqs.answer: Technical SEO is included in every plan from $199/month. On-page SEO, monthly blog content and Google Business Profile management are included on Growth at $399/month, and custom SEO strategy on Scale from $699/month.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee first-page rankings?
faqs.answer: No honest agency can guarantee rankings, because Google controls them. We follow proven best practices and report on progress every month.

faqs.question: What is local SEO?
faqs.answer: Local SEO helps your business appear in searches with local intent, like 'plumber near me' or 'dentist in Miami', including the Google Maps results.
